reviews.title: Great connection opportunities
reviews.text: Such a great platform. Has helped me in many ways. I give it 4 stars because they haven’t made it easy trying to stop the subscription and I’ve had to pay many times because it makes you jump through hoops just to cancel and is unclear if your subscription is active or not. They have made changes but it’s at one’s expense.

reviews.title: Stay Away!
reviews.text: You don’t pay for a lesson at an agreed upon time. You’re paying for a subscription. Horrible business model. No way to verify tutors can actually meet your needs before paying.

reviews.title: Beware of scammers!
reviews.text: My experience was a total scam. I thought I was communicating with a local tutor in my home city in the US… but when I got on the ‘1 hour free call’ it was someone from a completely different country. The account I had been communicating with was fictitious. Call only lasted 30mins and then they started asking for money. Total scam.

reviews.title: Scam alert
reviews.text: This app will require you to have a subscription that will not get charged unless someone responds, since they don’t have users, they use bots that respond In-order to charge you, the whole app runs on bots that they try to scam you. I would definitely recommend to stay away from this platform.

reviews.title: Hidden subscription fees
reviews.text: Signed up on website and was slammed with subscription fees I never authorized

reviews.title: Not at all worth it.
reviews.text: To start, I got charged twice. (It says if you see the transaction it’s just bank verification but it wasn’t it was an actual transaction. So it took 50 twice from. After emailing someone which took forever and a day to do. I was than given the “theirs no email to your account so we can’t help you” yet… I’m on the app clearly you took my money clearly… tried to change email as they suggested. Of course that doesn’t work, gives a spam like reply “request already sent” but there is no request. Even after 3 days of waiting. I feel the app it’s self is a scam. Not supposed to charge unless tutor accepts. You’re allowed to send the one request. Yet I got charged twice for a message that never got answered so I declined it. And now have to dispute charges and cancel my card since oh also you can remove your card.

reviews.title: Code never arrives to login
reviews.text: The login code never arrives, and there are so many bugs. Also, when searching for a teacher, the search results and filters should be saved instead of having to enter everything again every time.

reviews.title: Demanda
reviews.text: Es una compañía ladrona repórtenla. Dicen que no te van a cobrar hasta que un tutor acepte enseñarte y dicen que es 100%seguro pero es mentira lo primero que ellos hacen es sacarte el dinero de la targeta y luego no hay ningún tutor que pueda aceptar para enseñarte y luego tú pierdes tus $50 y ellos no te hacen el reembolso, los voy a demandará

reviews.text: makes organization for tutoring easy!

reviews.title: Good option
reviews.text: I’m happy that I was able to get a student within a few days of posting my ad.  The only frustration Is that sometimes the recommendation of my friends does not go through.  The website seems to have some bugs.

reviews.title: Best Tutoring platform
reviews.text: I'm honored to be one of the most searched tutors on Superprof for Organic Chemistry and MCAT preparation since last 4 years. A heartfelt thank you to the Superprof team for this recognition and for providing such a wonderful platform to connect with students. Truly grateful!

reviews.title: Fantastic app
reviews.text: Highly recommend for looking for professionals to teach you to develop your skill

reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS APP
reviews.text: I used it to try to find a tutor and had no luck so I deleted it. But then they kept charging my account for their subscription service so I deleted my subscription. BUT IM STILL BEING CHARGED!!!!!! Bad app do not recommend

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: Complete and total scam. Both profiles I contacted in my area were cat fishing with other peoples pictures and names, which considering I was looking for a DRIVING INSTRUCTOR, indicates that there is no ID upload in order to double check identities and make sure someone actually has a LICENSE to teach someone to drive. insanity. DO NOT USE.

reviews.title: A Great Platform for Connecting with Students
reviews.text:
Superprof has honestly been a really helpful platform for growing my teaching and connecting with students I probably wouldn’t have met otherwise. As a guitar teacher, I like how simple it is to set up my profile and start conversations with people who are actually interested in learning.

It feels pretty natural to use, and I’ve had a lot of good experiences with students so far. Most people I’ve worked with have been friendly, motivated, and easy to communicate with, which makes teaching a lot more enjoyable.

Overall, I’d definitely recommend Superprof to other teachers or professionals who want an easy way to find new students and share what they do.

reviews.title: The Experience
reviews.text: What a way to exchange knowledge and guide others through language barriers at the comfort of their home or person.

reviews.title: Good app to use
reviews.text: I’ve had 4 customers and this app has been very responsive and helpful with tutoring.

reviews.title: Most obvious scam
reviews.text: Support is AI and you cannot connect with a real person. You have to request a refund through email instead of everything being handled on the app. Payments also aren’t handled on the app through a third party connector. You actually have to send the tutor money via Zelle, Chime, and etc

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text:
You pay them to “maybe” find work as a tutor. Can’t add the subjects that they advertised a need for, eg Art. Can’t add your US phone number in app. Can’t delete account in app. Don’t bother! They advertise on Instagram just to get sign ups.

The company ludicrously claims that I must have downloaded a different version and that was why I had this experience - and says I have no account with them. Well that would be because I have closed my account.

reviews.title: Fraudulent platform
reviews.text: There have been no efforts to teach and setup. looks like some bots start engagement and then ghost. They didn’t even refund

reviews.title: IS NOT WORKING FOR ME
reviews.text: I opened a profile to teach and unless I pay 100$ right away my profile is never visible. So it’s been over a week I’ve had it and no one is actually seeing my profile.

reviews.title: Absolute SHAM
reviews.text: COMPLETE SHAM BASED WITH UTTER LIES AND NO  INTENT TO TEACH YOU A THING! I’ve attempted to use this platform three times to get a Spanish tutor and all attempts have ended in being mislead or rejected after the tutor ACCEPTED my request. The first time, I shockingly was able to schedule a call and it ended up not even being the person I wanted! She ended up being great but then GHOSTED ME amidst our lessons, then had to nerve to reach out after months with even higher rates. Next, I submitted for a professor recently, and the women accepts the lessons then says she “doesn’t have time to do lessons” after she literally accepted it and the company took my $49 deposit. I reported it and still haven’t received my refund. I figured foolishly “oh, maybe it was a fluke so it’s try again”, which was a poor decision. I submitted for another teacher, and she instantly accepted, then had no time to meet and left it fully open and never reached out. I reach out again and she says “I can’t help you” with no explanation. This platform is full of deception, deceitful liars who accept lessons with no intent to teach you, which is why I rate this app with 1 star.

reviews.title: Not what It seems
reviews.text: I was looking for a tutor and found options on this app. When I went to book it only prompted me to the student pass which seems like that’s the price you pay to meet with their tutors offered on the app. NO that’s just the fee you pay to be able to message and plan meets i guess with tutors on the app. Then you need to pay them separately……

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
They charge you 40$ a month, just to give you the ability to ASK for a tutor. It’s also done purposefully deceiving way.

Then! Their costumer support doesn’t respond.

Now I have to go the police office to file a report for a refund on the side of my bank. Great.
